name: vehicle-task-states-visual
description: Visual check: vehicle state transitions through idle moving working and waiting states

steps.description: Real click path: select hauler #1 in the 3D scene, rest the cursor on the destination, press the selection bar's MOVE HERE. The old description here claimed no UI drives this command and none should exist -- false since the SelectionBar gained `move_here` (G4), usable with a mouse since ScenePicking started latching `.aim` (47f4fef). DESTINATION CHANGED from (2,2) to (37,33): (2,2) sits in dusty_hollow's far corner behind a rise, and no camera-ray aim from the default orbit can land on it -- a focus sweep along x=2.5 jumps straight from tile z=0 to z=3, skipping 1 and 2, so the tile is occluded. This file tests idle -> moving -> transport task transitions, not one particular destination, so it aims at a tile a player can actually point at. (37,33) is the same tile vehicle-traffic-routing-visual drives to on this level, and its focus point was measured in a real browser until the dispatched command read `vehicle move 1 to:37,33`.

expect.note: vehicle list confirms idle → moving; no scalar field exists for vehicle task state

steps.description: Left unmarked: `vehicle assign <id> task:<task>` writes the VehicleTask enum straight onto the vehicle, skipping the drive/load/unload sequence ArrivalGate drives, so it reaches a state no real flow produces -- classified as a test-only state poke alongside `employee assign_skill` (gap G5). Every player-meaningful task has its own control: transport/loading -> Haul, clearing -> Break, moving -> the selection bar's MOVE HERE, which the step above now clicks.

expect.note: vehicle list confirms moving → transport, overriding the earlier move task
